sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Blocky Bird are straightforward yet engaging. Players control a little blocky Parrot that must navigate through a series of obstacles, collecting coins and avoiding enemies in the process. The game is played on a single screen, and players can use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to navigate the Parrot.

The Parrot can be controlled in two main ways: left and right movement, and jumping. Players can use the left and right arrow keys or mouse movement to control the Parrot's movement, while the space bar or the 'jump' button can be used to make the Parrot jump. The game's controls are responsive and intuitive, making it easy for players to navigate through the game's various levels.

One of the unique features of Blocky Bird is its use of a 'gravity' system. The Parrot can jump and fall, and players must use this to their advantage to navigate through the game's levels.
